moveOptionsOf — the ways to go for one leg, as the server sent them > keeps a taxi fare as the lowest it can be and a fare it was not given as unknown (never 0)
moveOptionsOf — the ways to go for one leg, as the server sent them > decides `fits` from the slack only when the server said nothing, and never turns an explicit unknown into late
